what: The exhaustive model in exhaustive/nested.rs was out of reach for a second lane in a row: the maintained step needed the engine's run, the lookup, the carry, the session's rows and the table's layout read first (about 100K tokens of a 200K context), and the model's file was never opened. Its controls (the three of part reads, and a maintainer that forgets a deletion) are in tests/cost.rs, on smaller hand-picked sequences.
cost: pieces 1(c) and 3 and the model half of piece 2 moved to a successor lane
whys: why the model was not reached: a change to how a step is run crosses `Engine::entered`, `run`, `lookup`, `check`, `carry` and `Reads`, all of which had to be read to place one call
why so much to read: `Engine::entered` held the lookup, the run and the keep in one body, with the session's posting between them
why the cost tests stand in: they can be written from the public API alone, the model cannot
cause: the model's ways are written against the kernel's internals in one 619-line file, so adding a way needs both the model and the internals in one context
class: a check that can only be extended by someone who has read everything it checks is extended by nobody
prevention: give the model a table of ways (a step set, its world edits, its oracle) that a new step is added to from the public API; a lane brief for the model alone, with nest.rs off its reading list
fix: owed: a lane whose only piece is the model (the table step, maintained, its four controls, the cover way)
